page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.xlarge is an x86_64 virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 4 dedicated Intel Xeon virtual processor cores operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 32.0 GB of memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes 0 GPUs and does not come bundled with local storage volumes, necessitating network-attached storage for operating system and data requirements. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Featuring an expanded 1:8 compute-to-memory distribution, the instance caters to environments where memory demands outpace compute needs. This configuration prevents over-provisioning compute resources solely to satisfy memory footprint demands. A primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of local disks, directing all storage input/output throughput across network interfaces alongside standard network traffic.

The ecs.u2i-c1m8.xlarge is structured for memory-heavy, moderate-compute services. Typical deployments include in-memory databases, Redis or Memcached caching tiers, relational database engines, message queues, and intermediate data processing workloads.
